topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Hey! I just heard about this fence idea, and I gotta say, it's a bit out of the blue. I mean, we've been neighbors for years, and it's always been so open and friendly between us. Thinking about a fence... it's throwing me. I get that everyone needs some privacy, but this feels like a big step. I hope it’s not because of something I did or said. I’d love to talk about it, maybe find a way to make sure everything’s still cool between us. Thoughts?
